3892.title: Renderer navigation does not request native preview cleanup
3892.rootCauseOneLine: Application renderer reload registration handles keyboard input but does not reset native preview visibility on document navigation.
3892.proposedFix: Wire full-document application navigation to existing window-scoped cleanup, then verify native event delivery and UI reattachment.
